bio_html: I am a Ph.D. student in Social Psychology at Syracuse University, working under the mentorship of Dr. Jeewon Oh. My research examines how people live healthy and happy lives through the lens of social ties and personality, with particular focus on friendships, singlehood, and well-being, using quantitative and qualitative methods. I hold an M.S. in Clinical Psychology from Morehead State University. Understanding how people build and sustain meaningful social connections has real-world implications for public health, as loneliness and social isolation are increasingly recognized as risk factors for both mental and physical health.
